title: An item being reworked leaves the waiting page
why: shiv, Oct 30 15:40 CDT: 'Item 97 is being reowrked? if so, why am i able to answer?' Read on main page.html: every item not closed shows with live options; the page has no hold state.
note: Fix: the waiting-page skill's writer rule says an item whose options are being reworked is closed off the page, with its home naming the rework, and comes back as a new item when the options are ready. No page code change. Done check: the skill text says so, and its item check refuses an open item whose context says 'being reworked'. Needs no answer.
